Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. original_prompt: Create an Ansible playbook that installs the OpenTelemetry Collector (binary or yum/apt repository), configures it to receive OTLP on port 4317 and export to a remote endpoint, and starts it as a systemd service.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Create an Ansible playbook that installs the OpenTelemetry Collector (binary or yum/apt repository), configures it to receive OTLP on port 4317 and export to a remote endpoint, and starts it as a systemd service.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Install and configure OpenTelemetry Collector
  hosts: all
  become: yes

  vars:
    collector_port: 4317
    export_endpoint: https://your-otlp-export-endpoint.com

  tasks:
  - name: Install OpenTelemetry Collector
    apt:
      name: opentelemetry-collector
      state: present

  - name: Configure OpenTelemetry Collector
    template:
      src: templates/collector.yaml.j2
      dest: /etc/otel/collector.yaml
      mode: '0644'
    notify: restart collector

  - name: Create systemd service file
    template:
      src: templates/collector.service.j2
      dest: /etc/systemd/system/otel-collector.service
      mode: '0644'
    notify: reload systemd

  - name: Enable and start OpenTelemetry Collector service
    systemd:
      name: otel-collector
      state: started
      enabled: yes

  handlers:
  - name: restart collector
    systemd:
      name: otel-collector
      state: restarted

  - name: reload systemd
    systemd:
      daemon_reload: yes

  - name: Create templates directory if it doesn't exist
    file:
      path: templates
      state: directory
      mode: '0755'

  - name: Create collector.yaml template
    template:
      src: templates/collector.yaml.j2
      dest: templates/collector.yaml
      mode: '0644'
    vars:
      collector_port: "{{ collector_port }}"
      export_endpoint: "{{ export_endpoint }}"

  - name: Create collector.service template
    template:
      src: templates/collector.service.j2
      dest: templates/collector.service
      mode: '0644'

---
templates/collector.yaml.j2:
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocol: http
    host: 0.0.0.0
    port: {{ collector_port }}
exporters:
  otlp:
    endpoint: {{ export_endpoint }}
    insecure: false
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [otlp]

templates/collector.service.j2:
[Unit]
Description=OpenTelemetry Collector
After=network.target

[Service]
User=otel
ExecStart=/usr/bin/otelcol --config=/etc/otel/collector.yaml
Restart=always

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
